subject.title: fix(plugins): allow runtime.llm.complete to pass reasoning effort

question: Should the shipped `runtime.llm.complete` plugin API permanently expose the full OpenClaw thinking-level vocabulary for reasoning effort?
rationale: This is an additive bug fix, but the accepted values become an external plugin contract and the exact vocabulary cannot be safely chosen from implementation convenience alone.

options.title: Approve the canonical optional field
options.body: Confirm one public OpenClaw reasoning-effort type and merge after live provider proof demonstrates explicit and omitted behavior.

options.title: Defer the API expansion
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose a narrower model-neutral reasoning contract or another plugin API shape.

recommendation.title: Approve the canonical optional field
